overview: The Medford City Council met to address community concerns including South Medford resident permit parking, school zone crossing guard coverage, and police presence in Medford Square. The council also gave final approval to an ordinance raising the tobacco purchasing age to 21 and a $1.8 million loan order for City Hall repairs.

items.title: Portal to Hope Announcement
items.summary: Director Deborah Fallon announced an upcoming candlelight vigil for Domestic Violence Awareness Month on October 26 and updated the council on Portal to Hope's services in Medford.

items.title: South Medford Resident Permit Parking
items.summary: The council discussed resident permit parking challenges in South Medford and approved a motion to forward neighborhood parking recommendations to the Traffic Commission while requesting information on ParkMedford operations.

items.title: Pedestrian Signal Timing at Fellsway West and Fulton Street
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting the Department of Conservation and Recreation to extend pedestrian crossing time at Fellsway West and Fulton Street and provide a list of state-controlled crosswalks in Medford.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Anthony Silva
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family of Anthony Silva, a Korean War Army veteran and longtime Medford resident.

items.title: Brooks School Crossing Guard Coverage and School Traffic Safety
items.summary: Approved a resolution addressing a missing crossing guard incident at Brooks School and requesting police updates, improved communication equipment for guards, and volunteer support across school zones.

items.title: Police Presence in Medford Square
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting increased police patrols in Medford Square to address merchant and resident complaints regarding loitering, panhandling, and public drinking.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Noise Complaints
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration regarding unresolved noise complaints from Terrace Road residents concerning Lawrence Memorial Hospital.

items.title: Honor Roll Park Veteran Names
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a list of applicant veterans and a schedule for adding their names to the Honor Roll Park monument.

items.title: Public Participation on Council Rules
items.summary: Resident Cheryl Rodriguez spoke regarding City Council rules of order and presented citywide traffic accident data; the paper was received and placed on file.

items.title: Tobacco Purchase Age Ordinance
items.summary: Approved on third reading an ordinance raising the legal age to purchase tobacco products in Medford from 18 to 21.

items.title: City Hall Roof and Facade Loan Order
items.summary: Approved on third reading an $1,800,000 loan order to finance repairs to the City Hall roof and facade.

items.title: Community Announcements and Election Information
items.summary: Councilors shared announcements regarding a local medical fundraiser, upcoming police community meetings, and early voting schedules for the general election.
